frontmatter.name: orchestrator
frontmatter.description: Runs the whole build/check loop for the portfolio website. Reads TASK.md, drives each task/feature through Builder → Checker cycles (max 5), enforces a final verification pass, and writes the run log. Use this to execute the work defined in TASK.md. It manages the Builder and Checker; it does not write feature code itself.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep, Agent
